name: imessage-mcp
description: Slack-style context over your iMessages: conversations, group chats, full-text search, photos, files and real contact names.
long_description: Gives Claude useful access to your Messages history on macOS. List conversations by activity, read DMs and group chats by contact or group name, search every message, browse, read and save the photos, PDFs and documents people send, see unread messages grouped by conversation, and send to a resolved person or group, now or at a scheduled time, or leave a draft in the chat for you to send yourself. Senders are shown by contact name, and Claude can add contacts or update their names, numbers and emails in the Contacts app. Messages are read locally and read-only from your Mac; nothing is uploaded. Requires Full Disk Access for Claude (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access), and access to Contacts the first time you add or edit a contact. Not affiliated with Apple.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List DMs and group chats by recent activity with unread counts and previews

tools.name: read_conversation
tools.description: Read a DM or group chat by name, phone, email or chat ref

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by name, phone or email

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Add a contact to the Contacts app, unless one already has that number or email

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Change a contact's name, company, phone numbers or emails, showing before and after

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: Browse the files, photos and videos sent in a conversation, by type, name and date

tools.name: view_attachments
tools.description: See the photos in a message and read its PDFs, documents and text files

tools.name: save_attachment
tools.description: Copy a message's attachments to a folder, Downloads by default

tools.name: send_imessage
tools.description: Send a message now to one resolved person or group chat

tools.name: draft_imessage
tools.description: Put a message in a chat's compose box without sending it, for you to review and send

tools.name: schedule_imessage
tools.description: Schedule a message to be sent later, even with Claude closed

tools.name: list_scheduled_imessages
tools.description: List scheduled messages, including any that were missed
